distribution: In China recorded from Guangxi and from Manyun, Yingjiang, Yunnan; abroad from Sumatra, Indonesia.
soldier: Head and antennae brownish yellow, abdomen pale yellow. The hairs of the head very sparse, those of the abdomen denser. Head oval, widest at the middle, in profile its dorsum flatly rounded with the highest point at the middle of the vertex; postmentum markedly projecting and broader behind. Mandibles sickle-shaped: the inner margin of the left mandible with two to three triangular notches behind the midpoint, and sometimes several small projections forming a serrate surface in front of the midpoint; the posterior section of the right mandible with several small notches, but these are not very distinct. The front of the labrum narrow, the lateral margins rounded, with long hairs in longitudinal rows along the margins. Antennae with 16 segments, the third and fourth shortest, the fourth sometimes shorter than the third. The middle of both the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum concave.
taxonomy_note: The original work places this species in the genus Parahypotermes; this site now treats it under Hypotermes, the genus name having changed.
